manifest_binding: MANIFEST.sha256 contains every package path and content hash except itself; SOURCE_ALLOWLIST.txt contains the exact payload paths; payload_manifest_sha256 is sha256 of the lexicographically sorted, newline-terminated '<sha256>  <path>' lines of the payload; prior_deployment_content_aggregate_sha256 is that same value computed over the app tree (excluding __pycache__) of release-2026.10.11-claude-provider, the production deployment this package supersedes (it equals that package's payload_manifest_sha256). active_release is the staged, not yet activated, release directory built from this payload with a fresh venv
excluded_classes: production uploads, outputs, progress, tasks, caches, logs and installer state
fonts, audit evidence, backups and Git metadata
